title: J.P. Morgan Called a Potential Elon Musk SpaceX-Tesla Merger "Strategically Coherent"
title_zh: 摩根大通称埃隆·马斯克 SpaceX 与特斯拉的潜在合并“战略一致”
summary: J.P. Morgan just outlined why a SpaceX-Tesla merger could make strategic sense on paper. It also got into why investors shouldn't mistake that for a likely deal.
summary_zh: 摩根大通刚刚概述了为什么 SpaceX 与特斯拉的合并在纸上具有战略意义。它还解释了为什么投资者不应将其误认为是可能的交易。

title: Big banks kick off Q2 earnings, June CPI offers inflation insights: What to watch this week
title_zh: 大银行公布第二季度财报，6 月 CPI 提供通胀见解：本周关注点
summary: Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch this week, including the latest CPI reading and quarterly earnings reports from Netflix (NFLX), Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM), JPMorgan (JPM), Bank of America (BAC),...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 仔细研究了本周投资者关注的头条新闻，包括 Netflix (NFLX)、台积电 (TSM)、摩根大通 (JPM)、美国银行 (BAC) 等的最新 CPI 读数和季度收益报告。

title: Apollo Gatecrashes easyJet’s Takeover Flight
title_zh: 阿波罗计划破坏了易捷航空的收购航班
summary: The US buyout giant has topped Castlelake’s offer with a £5.7 billion proposal, turning easyJet from budget airline into premium bidding-war cargo.
summary_zh: 这家美国收购巨头以 57 亿英镑的报价超越了 Castlelake 的报价，将易捷航空从廉价航空公司转变为优质的竞购战货运航空公司。

title: Apollo hijacks easyJet takeover with £5.7bn bid, trumping Castlelake
title_zh: 阿波罗以 57 亿英镑的出价击败卡斯尔莱克，劫持易捷航空收购
summary: The budget airline easyJet has swung behind a £5.7 billion (€6.6bn) takeover proposal from the US private equity giant Apollo, abandoning its support for a rival American bidder days after agreeing to that offer.View on euronews
summary_zh: 廉价航空公司易捷航空 (easyJet) 转而支持美国私募股权巨头阿波罗 (Apollo) 的 57 亿英镑（66 亿欧元）收购提议，并在同意该提议几天后放弃了对美国竞争对手的支持。

title: $35 Billion AI Credit Deal Nears Trading as Broadcom Financing Advances
title_zh: 随着博通融资的推进，350 亿美元的人工智能信贷交易即将完成交易
summary: About $15 billion of the AI infrastructure financing could become tradable by early next year.
summary_zh: 到明年初，大约 150 亿美元的人工智能基础设施融资可能可以进行交易。
